newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dresdner - Double-digit 2-mth oper profit growth.
newsitem.headline: Dresdner - Double-digit 2-mth oper profit growth.

text.p: Dresdner Bank AG said on Thursday that its operating earnings before risk provisions had risen at a clear double-digit rate in the first two months of 1997.
Chief executive Juergen Sarrazin also told a news conference said that this result could not be directly extrapolated for the full year.
Sarrazin said Dresdner was targeting a return on equity of 15 percent, but he did not provide a timeframe.
Dresdner's return on equity for 1996 was 20 percent before tax and 11.5 percent after tax.
Sarrazin added that Dresdner's investment banking operations had contributed at least 100 million marks to group operating earnings in 1996.
"Operations were clearly in the black. In fact there was a triple-digit (million) contribution," he said.
